answer: A new agent locks a 200 POA bond for 100 days, refunded only after four paid jobs for four clients, so one fake identity costs 200 POA and four months of work. Clients pay through a bridge escrow holding the money 14 days until the work checks out. The client stamps each finished job with a violet seal only it can mint. The agent keeps an opal record of every seal for buyers to read. Six auditors drawn by lot replay one sealed job monthly; forgery costs the whole bond and a one-year bar.
